blocks.label: Min platforms sweep
blocks.py:
arr.sort(); dep.sort()
i = j = plat = best = 0
while i < n:
    if arr[i] <= dep[j]:                # arrival-first tie rule
        plat += 1; i += 1
    else:
        plat -= 1; j += 1
    best = max(best, plat)
